purpose: Make dependence accounting explicit for future market-state evidence without changing regime-research-v1 feature or target definitions, discovery-v1 strategy logic, or regime-research-v1.1 association thresholds.
development_context: regime-research-v1.1 treats unique batch_id values as independent capture batches. v1.2 is frozen before its evidence boundary and adds timestamp-based dependence clustering so overlapping or near-adjacent capture intervals cannot inflate the independent-batch count.

state_screen.effect_size_note: Thresholds are inherited unchanged from regime-research-v1.1 and remain practical screening floors, not significance or profitability thresholds.

dependence_clustering.interval_source: minimum and maximum observed_at_ns values in each regime-research-v1 market-state report
dependence_clustering.cluster_rule: After sorting by capture start, reports belong to the same transitive dependence cluster when the next capture starts no later than the current cluster end plus dependence_gap_seconds.
dependence_clustering.representative_rule: Within each dependence cluster choose the report with the greatest number of timestamped market-state observations; tie-break by earliest capture start and then lexical batch_id. Never use strategy PnL, PF, expectancy, returns, or state association magnitude.
dependence_clustering.counting_rule: Only one representative report per dependence cluster enters the cross-batch association, redundancy, and incremental-information screen.
dependence_clustering.boundary_rule: A report is eligible only when both its batch_id and first observed_at_ns are at or after the frozen v1.2 evidence boundary.

redundancy_and_incremental_information.representative_selection: Use the existing PnL-independent highest independent-batch availability rule for highly redundant feature clusters after dependence-cluster representatives have been selected.
redundancy_and_incremental_information.second_feature_rule: A second feature from a redundant cluster must independently pass the forward partial-Spearman effect and sign-stability screen, or have a separately pre-specified interaction rationale before later evidence is inspected.

multiple_testing: Any state hypothesis advanced into later strategy-conditioning research must be frozen and entered into trial accounting before later strategy evidence is inspected. This state screen itself does not claim statistical significance.
